meta.title: Interface polish
meta.description: One appearance layer for every plugin: buttons highlight on hover, keyboard focus is visible, fields and scrollbars follow the theme, long paragraphs are justified, and plugin descriptions collapse. The left sidebar gets shortcut panels for all our plugins (Cards, Dialog compression, Review changes, Notifications, Team, Vault, Pyrus, Inbox, Interface polish, Whale helper, Launch browser), so any plugin can be pinned; unpinned ones stay in the “More” menu with an “Unpinned panels” list and Pin buttons. Its own page shows the environment health (sync, GitHub token, Chrome, MCP, versions) and can check and install plugin updates. The appearance can be switched off with one checkbox.
